acceptanceCriteria: ci-control-plane.yml has a concurrency group keyed by head SHA (or PR) so superseded runs collapse
Cancelled CI runs do not start a control-plane run, or the job exits in under 10 s without a runner-heavy step; AFP-V0-016/047 wording updated if behavior changes
A measured window shows queued control-plane runs no longer exceed the number of distinct open heads
body: Observed 2026-10-18 ~14:30Z: 13 queued `CI control plane` workflow_run runs on main (e.g. 39132313716), each 3 jobs, behind the same ~2 runner capacity as PR and merge_group CI. .github/workflows/ci-control-plane.yml triggers on every CI `completed` event, so cancelling a superseded run (the batching default cancels constituent runs) still spawns a control-plane run, and ci:batched constituent PRs each spawn one even though they will never merge on their own head. Expected: control-plane work does not grow with cancelled/superseded runs; one run per head, skipped for cancelled conclusions where no status is needed, with a concurrency group per head SHA (cancel-in-progress) so a burst collapses. The forward-rows job still records one row per completed run (AFP-V0-047) or records why a cancelled run has none. Needs the .github consent / ci-control-plane post from the owner.
title: CI control plane runs once per completed CI run (including cancelled and ci:batched ones) and queues 13+ deep on the shared runners
